parameters.name: X-Tenant-Id
parameters.description: Tenant to scope the request to. Required on multi-tenant hosts.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Required. Wire event name. One of: sales_order.created, sales_order.shipped, sales_order.cancelled, purchase_order.created, purchase_order.approved, purchase_order.submitted, purchase_order.received, inventory.adjusted, product.created, customer.created.
